meta.notes: points = the 25 frozen candidates on holdout seeds 2000-2019 (central): capital = simulated time-average spare capital, aog_hours = material AOG h/yr, 95% CIs over seeds. kind: policy (P0/P1/P2) / greedy (subkind budget = re-optimised allocation, incremental = P2 + greedy additions) / lever / combo. dominated = computed here from the HOLDOUT means over all 25 points (minimise capital and AOG h); selection_dominated / selection_on_hull = the optimiser's selection-seed flags. recommended = the pre-stated rule applied on SELECTION seeds (summary.json), not re-chosen on holdout. B250 has one unstable holdout seed (very wide CI); reported, not removed (D011). allocations = rows vs P2, top 40 per point by |modelled AOG-hour reduction| (analytic model, leave-one-out, not simulated) with untrimmed totals in allocation_totals; 'reason' kept for the recommended point only. levers = levers.csv (annual-basis lever comparison at the P2 allocation, modelled). tornado = net benefit of the recommended point vs P2 (AED/yr); low/high are differences from the base case.

recommendation.rule: Stated before computing. Among the capital-only candidates (baseline/reference policies, budget points, base+additions, reposition), take the non-dominated set on the selection-seed means (minimise simulated capital and material AOG h/yr) and its lower convex hull, sorted by capital. Walking up the hull, each segment's marginal value is the AOG-hour reduction per extra AED 1M of capital. The break-even value implied by the AOG penalty is h* = carrying % x AED 1M / (baseline AED per AOG hour), i.e. the AOG hours whose penalty equals the extra annual holding cost of AED 1M. The recommended 'balanced' point is the last hull vertex before the first segment whose marginal value falls below h* (equivalently the hull point that minimises carrying % x capital + AED/h x AOG hours). If no segment falls below h*, the highest-capital vertex is recommended and flagged 'frontier not saturated'.

aog_desk_dependence.text: Every policy here, P0/P1/P2 included, relies on the v2 AOG-desk routes (V2-SIM-5/14, config aog_sourcing, ASSUMED): robbery at AUH (engineering/quality approval required), local borrow at outstations and exchange/loan by fleet, retried every 72 h for rotables, plus local buy for C/E; in practice this means access to an AOG exchange/loan market and to borrow agreements. Borrowed units never join the owned pool. With the routes switched off (tornado row 'aog_desk_expedite off'), expected material-related downtime rises sharply for every policy, so the frontier is conditional on those markets existing at the assumed availability.
